QUOTE: "`code` | process predates the source tree | restart the MCP client; rebuilding will not help" and "The code notice says the query data is current even though the logic is old." and "`stale_code_refusal` blocks writes from a stale process and ignores `force`." and "`_data_stale` returns false if the process predates its source, so an auto-refresh never writes an index with old logic."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that on the code axis the query data stays current while the logic is old, and that builds from a stale process are refused because they would write an index with old logic. That is the read/write asymmetry.
